name: filter-spring
title: Filter Spring
description: Writes a filter-schema AST as the `filter` param of turkraft's Spring Filter: `status : 'open' and (amount >: 10 or owner is null)`, for JPA or MongoDB.
docs: `springFilter(toFilterAst(schema, values), { module, like })` returns the `filter` param. Strings are single-quoted with backslash escapes; `module: "jpa"` (default) matches text with `%` and refuses `%`, `_` and `*` inside it, `"mongo"` uses `*`, and `like: "~~"` ignores case. It takes `fields` and `dates` like every serializer and throws a `FilterSerializeError` for what it can't write safely. Pair it with `springPageSource` from `page-source-spring` for the paging.
